title: HCF Health Insurance - 6 Weeks Free after 90 Days + $300 Mastercard after 4 Months (via OneBigSwitch)
body:
Deal: HCF Health Insurance - 6 Weeks Free after 90 Days + $300 Mastercard after 4 Months (via OneBigSwitch)

[ce5himm] Saw this the other day on Facebook, can I trust this website?
[benwaffle] If you live in WA and have RAC membership then you get $400 Visa gift card for combined family cover along with the 6 weeks free and waived 2 month waiting periods
https://rac.com.au/home-life/health-insurance
[ausmisc] I was looking at this yesterday and did notice this in the terms. I'm not sure how common it is to exclude certain cover levels but thought I'd stick it here in case it helps someone not miss out.
To be a new eligible member for this Offer, you must be an Australian resident, aged 18 years or over, you must take out combined HCF hospital & extras cover (excluding any Gold level, Bronze Plus and My Family cover and Overseas Visitors Health Cover)
[aiyoyo] Gosh, I just transfer from AHM to HCF 2 weeks ago! Can I still get this deal?
[Wiadro] i recently got a email from HBF for being a member for 6 months.
they must really want people to leave ASAP
[Iwantthebestprice] Is the $300 Mastercard tiered? Like $300 for couples and $150 for singles? Or just $300 flat.
And second, I’m with NIB, is this a HCF insurance affiliate?
[U30004] $300 for couples. $100 for single. I am eith nib as well, will be switching to hcf
[pulsez] HBF have a similar deal going for new joins but instead for a $200 gift card ($100 for singles) after 31 days but 12 weeks free - dished out over 26 months just to make sure you stay (31 days - 4 weeks free, 13 months - another 4 weeks free, 26 months - last 4 weeks free).
